ItemID: 1; Title: Tungsten Carbide Burr Set 1/4" Shank 8PC Double Cut Rotary Cutting Burrs Die Grinder Bits for Steel and Wood Working, Grinding, Carving, and Engraving; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: Deburring and shaping metal fits my recent drilling and fastening projects; I would check shank compatibility before buying.
ItemID: 2; Title: Duct Tape Heavy Duty Waterproof Bulk of 5, 11 Mils Black Duct Tape 2 inches x 33 Yards, Max Strength No Residue Industrial Tape, Tear by Hand for DIY Repairs, Industrial, All-Weather Multipurpose Use; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: General repair tape would complement the specialty adhesive tapes I have been buying, though five rolls is a large supply.
ItemID: 3; Title: Benilev Female Pelvis Model with Pelvic Floor Muscles Perineal Model Female Anatomy Model 1:1 Life Size Human Skeleton Medical Science Educational Equipment Anatomy Medicine; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I have no current anatomy study or medical teaching need; my recent interests center on workshop projects.
ItemID: 4; Title: Sworker Carbide Burr Set Compatible with Dremel 1/8" Shank 20PC Die Grinder Rotary Tool Rasp Bits Wood Carving Accessories Attachments Cutting Burrs Metal Grinding Engraving Porting Double Cut; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The shaping bits interest me, but I would choose only one burr set after checking which shank fits my equipment.
ItemID: 5; Title: VIGRUE 1/4 x 1" to 3" Hex Lag Bolts, 108PCS 1/4 Hex Lag Screws Wood Screws Washers Assortment kit 18-8(304) Stainless Steel; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: Larger wood fasteners would extend my assortment beyond the smaller machine screws and nuts I recently bought.
ItemID: 6; Title: 24x Replacement Trigger Sprayer Nozzles Heavy Duty Industrial Commercial 28-400 Cleaning Chemical / Acid Resistant - Top Squirt Part Lid Only 16oz / 32oz Spray Bottle Glass and Plastic 9.25" Dip Tube; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I do not currently need bulk replacement sprayers, and my earlier dropper bottles do not establish a compatible use.
ItemID: 7; Title: Joywayus Pressure Gauge 0 to 30 PSI Brass 1/4" Male NPT Thread Lower Mount, Multiple Function; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Measurement tools interest me, but I have no current pressure-testing project requiring this range and fitting.
ItemID: 8; Title: JOMERON 84PCS Lever Nuts Wire Connectors kit,2 3 5 Port Electrical Lever Wire Connectors Assortment Pack kit for Quick Connect, pushin Compact Splicing Electrical Connectors for Wiring 28-12 AWG; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: A connector assortment looks useful for repair work and fits my habit of keeping practical fastening supplies available.
ItemID: 9; Title: MUTUACTOR 2Packs Large Capability Heavy Duty Magnetic Hooks,Strong Magnet Hooks Storage Hooks for Hanging Power Tools Powerful Magnetic Hooks for Grill Utensils Tools Impact Drivers and Power Tools; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: These could help organize workshop tools, continuing the organizing use that drew me to adhesive hook-and-loop strips.
ItemID: 10; Title: M5 x 25mm (50 pcs) Button Head Socket Cap Sheet Metal Screws, 304 Stainless Steel 18/8, Allen Hex Drive 3mm, Wood Screws with Self Tapping Point; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: These fit my fastening interests, but I already bought several screw assortments and would wait until a project needs this specific size.
